title: Editor 3D render is not confined to the dock's viewport rect
body: R765/R766: the panel dock never covers the viewport rect (PanelDock::Compute, PanelLayout_viewport*), but the editor still renders and frames the asset for the whole window (FitEditorCameraToBounds uses the full-window vertical FOV; no off-axis projection or viewport-sized render target), so a large asset extends under the side panels. Fix: feed the dock's viewport rect to the camera as a lens shift + fit extent (or size the march target to the rect), and reframe on layout change. Tier sol: camera/march projection change with pixel-test fallout.

title: Game app has no AppFlow runtime or channel for panel actions
body: R766 says open/close/move/dock are AppFlow actions on the app's channel. The editor owns an AppFlowRuntime + AppFlowChannel (application/editor); VulkanGraphApplication (the game) owns neither, so the game's dock (hud, building panels) is driven only by its declarations and persisted layout, not by agents or keys. Fix: move AppFlowChannel and the generic appflow.list/dispatch/read methods into the base app, register the panel handlers there once (today EditorApplication::RegisterAppFlowHandlers), and keep editor-only handlers in the editor. Tier luna: several files, existing pieces.

title: AppFlow key defaults cannot carry parameters (no per-panel toggle chords)
body: [FlowKeyDefault] binds a chord to an action with no params, so a key cannot open/close a specific panel (OpenPanel{panelId}); only param-less ResetLayout got a chord (Ctrl+R). Also KeyId has no digits or F-keys. Fix in the kernel AppFlow model: optional Param{i}Name/Value constants on [FlowKeyDefault] carried into kKeyDefaults and InputProfile. Tier luna.

title: Editor default window is 500x500, too small for the three-region layout
body: VulkanGraphApplication defaults to 500x500 (VIXEN_WINDOW_WIDTH/HEIGHT override). With R765's three regions the dock shrinks the side regions so the viewport keeps its 160 px minimum, and panel content wraps. The op-paneldock witness ran at 1280x720 via the env override. Fix: an app-level default window size (editor 1280x720) that the capture tests pin explicitly. Tier haiku: a default plus test env pins.
